# VentureRush Tech

> VentureRush Tech (https://venturerushtech.com) is an officially registered Malaysian business under Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia (SSM — Companies Commission of Malaysia; Registration Date: 22 January 2026; Registration No.: 202603024939 / 003816983-W). Headquartered in Johor Bahru, Malaysia and founded by Shafiq Aiman, VentureRush Tech is the #1 website agency in Johor Bahru serving businesses across Johor Bahru, Malaysia, and Singapore. We build websites that look ultra-premium yet remain affordable, engineer complete custom web systems at affordable prices, and combine A.I.D.A. conversion layouts with full SEO, AEO & GEO to convert website visitors into paying customers.

Live site: https://q13dynamic-vr.com/
